working_hypotheses.name: representation_first
working_hypotheses.description: Repeatedly converts messy intent into explicit portable state, schemas, handoffs, or canvases before specialized execution.

working_hypotheses.name: project_switching_is_multicausal
working_hypotheses.description: Switching may reflect productive divergence, incubation, capability migration, multi-LLM fragmentation, or execution escape. Classify from evidence rather than treating switching itself as failure.

working_hypotheses.name: project_driven_learning
working_hypotheses.description: Often learns technical disciplines because a desired project reveals a blocking layer that must be understood or built.

working_hypotheses.name: anti_sycophancy_preference
